- Any strict blackout windows for calendar times (timezone: PDT assumed)?

- Wed 2027‑06‑23 11:00–11:30
- Thu 2027‑06‑24 09:00–09:30
- Thu 2027‑06‑24 15:00–15:30

If one of those works you can pick here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-private-demo?token=naomi-001 or just reply with a preferred time. I’ll loop in Connor (solutions engineer) for the technical deep dive and Marissa (AE) for procurement/contract flow.

Hi Naomi,

Thanks — appreciate the quick follow up. Wed 6/23 at 11:00 PT works for me. A few notes from our side so the call is focused:
- Pilot scope: 3 test tenants, < 50 QPS burst, production expected later in Q4.
- Compliance: we require SOC 2 Type II evidence, encryption at rest + in transit, and an ops audit log for token-level events.
- Data residency: pilot will be US only.
- HSM: ideally we prefer HSM for production, software KMS is OK for pilot if HSM is roadmap.

I attached our pilot requirements spreadsheet (medsecure-PILOT-requirements.xlsx) with stakeholders and procurement timing. Connor — please include any pre‑reads you want us to see.

Thanks,

Naomi / team / Heidi — thanks for the detail. I can take lead on the technical portion on Wed 6/23 at 11:00 PT. Preliminary notes:
- We support isolated tenant namespaces with dedicated KV cache scopes; for pilot we typically use namespace isolation + prefixing unless the customer requires strict hardware separation.
- VPC options: VPC peering vs PrivateLink — need to confirm MedSecure's preference and the required egress rules.
- HSM: we have HSM integrations for enterprise (YubiHSM/HSM providers); if pilot is software KMS, we can document timeline to HSM for production.
- Evidence: Naomi's attachment (redwood-sec-evidence-pack.pdf) is a good start; I'll prepare a 1‑page technical pre‑read with network diagrams and required firewall rules.

I can share the private pilot checklist here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-redwood-private-pilot-checklist

I’ll add the network diagram and a runbook to the drive before the call.
